title: What will fit between the meetings?
description: Meetings and tasks on a single day timeline. You can see the free intervals and the consequences of a reschedule before changing the plan.

blocks.text: The task list stays as it was, even though a new meeting has taken the free hour. The person has to work out separately which things can still be done.

quote.text: I like seeing my calendar and tasks in one screen.  The time-sensitive information on my calendar affects how many tasks I do and when I do them.

blocks.text: Join meetings and tasks on one timeline. The person sets an approximate length for a task and picks a free interval. When something is moved, what shifts and what no longer fits is visible first; the proposed plan can be corrected.

Give a person their own busy day and add one meeting. If they can choose which task to move without calculating alongside, the shared view is helping the decision. Two lists simply sitting next to each other does not show that yet.
